# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus contains a large volume of calls, but only a modest subset are genuine sales/enquiry/negotiation calls relevant to a training knowledge base. A significant portion of the transcripts are: (a) pure logistics/MTC-tag/test-certificate/loading-unloading operational chatter (Site Vinoth, VMK Pillai, Yuvraj Operator cutting-machine calls), (b) personal/unrelated conversations (the many "Vishal" calls are personal chatter, market gossip, cricket, family talk — not sales), and (c) short "send me rate / WhatsApp pannunga" calls with almost no content. After filtering, the real sales signal comes from a recurring set of dealer/customer accounts — Uniqcore Const (Balakrishnan), V R Earth Movers, Vinayaga Steel (Pradeep), Vidveda Krishnasamy/Vignesh, V SRIDHAR (Sivakesava Engineers), Venkatesan, Vasanth Narasimhan Engg, Vijaya Steels Vizag/Vijayawada, Vijayalakshmi Builder, VJR Developers, Zetwork Harish, Yuvaraj Elumalai (Rani Engineering), Vinodini Sharathi, Vanniar Narendrakumar, Vimaladevi K, Vishal Praful Mehta, Yashil Mayurkumar Shah, Vizag Duysthan (transport), among others. These give genuine rate quotes, objections, negotiation patterns, and closing behavior. The company (referred to as Bharat Steel / BSC) sells **MS/structural steel products** — plates, sheets (CR/HR), angles, channels (ISMB/ISMC/ISA), flats, square/rectangle pipes, TMT rebar (CRS/sale), and does cutting/processing (coil-to-sheet, shearing) — sourced from mills like Vizag (RINL), SAIL, Tata Steel, JSW, with "Vaisakh" (Vizag/Visakhapatnam) as a dominant commodity grade. No roofing sheets or allied products are mentioned; keep scope strictly to MS steel/structural/plate/TMT trading as shown.

## Products & brand ladder

- **MS Plates** (checkered & normal): thickness 2mm–45mm+, standard sizes like 2500x1250(4x8), 6300mm length coils cut to size. Quoted mostly from Vizag stock.
- **HR Sheets/Coils cut to size**: 2.5mm–12mm range, cut-to-length service (coil cutting machine ops frequently discussed).
- **CR (Cold Rolled) Coil Sheets**: e.g., 0.6mm CR for IS 513 matching, sourced via known vendors, not standard BSC stock.
- **Structural steel**: ISMB, ISMC/channel, ISA angle, flats (e.g., 50x5, 100x6, 150x75 IBM), square/rectangle pipes (local brands + Apollo + Tata for select sizes).
- **TMT Rebar / CRS (Corrosion Resistant Steel)**: grades mentioned — Fe500, Fe550D, E250, E350 (extra ₹3000 for E350). "Sale 500D" is standard in CRS; 550D rare/unavailable at times (RINL production gaps mentioned).
- **Build-up/PEB sections**: explicitly declined — "அது உங்க fabricator தான்... நாங்க pack பண்றது இல்ல."
- **Brand ladder**: Vizag/RINL ("Vaisakh") = default commodity brand, cheapest, always available; **SAIL** = used interchangeably in some tags/MTC (confusion noted in several calls); **Tata Steel** = premium, limited availability, used only for specific items (pipe/flat/angle first-2-items), rate "ரொம்ப high"; **JSW** = referenced as a market mover ("JSW ₹1000 increase பண்ணிருக்காங்க") — BSC doesn't stock JSW directly but tracks its price moves as a signal for Vizag/Sale price direction; **NMDC** = used for plates in some deals.
- Local/unbranded variants exist for lower-tier/odd sizes (e.g., round bars, local pipe/flat) when big mills don't produce small quantities.

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

- HR plate (main make): **₹66 + tax**, thickness up to 10–12mm; beyond that **+₹1000–2000 extra**. (Uniqcore)
- ISMB/Channel/Angle: **₹65–67** range, same as plate. MS round: **₹68–70** (via Vizag).
- Tata rate example: customer pushback on **₹78**; negotiation around taking "50%" at old rate, transport ~**₹1200/ton** (min 10–14 ton load).
- 6mm sheet / market check: **₹61–61.5** (plate, 2–5mm range similar); 2mm slightly higher at **₹63**.
- 8mm sheet 1500mm width: **₹59,500** per unit lot (~₹595/unit calc shown); Tata comparator quoted at ₹60/kg by customer.
- Structural steel sheet (8mm, 2500mm): **₹65.5** (up from "59–58" earlier; +₹1500 increase that month).
- Flat (V Kumar / Madam): starting ask ₹54, negotiated **final ₹53.50 + GST + loading + transport**, for 5.5m length (treated as 18 feet). ~₹23,000 difference over 23 tons discussed as "wastage tolerance."
- V R Earth Movers 300x150 vs 300x140 channel: **₹60 vs ₹63** (weight/flange trade-off: 42kg/m vs 46kg/m); final settled at **₹63** for 300x140 "Joyster" brand; price later moved to ₹63 kg confirmed.
- MS flat 8x4 size, 6mm plate: **₹66 + GST**; later another call quotes **₹67 + GST** for same spec (price drift week to week).
- Plate 8mm/5mm (Vinayaga Steel Pradeep): base **₹64**, customer negotiated down to **₹63.5**.
- Checkered/normal plate market checks: **₹61–63.5** moving band over several weeks (price volatility tracked call to call).
- TMT (Vimalkumar/Saveetha): **12mm ₹69, 16mm ₹68.5**, + GST extra, "16mm discount ₹500 possible, 12mm no discount."
- CRS 20mm Sale (Vanniar/Narendrakumar): **₹69,000** (per ton equivalent), loading free offered as concession; sample policy: "1 meter sample = 1 piece only," customer must collect.
- TMT via Yasil Mayurkumar (Mumbai trader): SE 550D grade, price negotiation stuck on **100% advance payment before dispatch** — no partial/token acceptable despite customer offering ₹1–2 lakh token.
- VIMALADEVI K (TMT rod for bolts): standard length is **12 meter only, no 6m cut**; customer must arrange own trailer/transport for 12m loads; check pending on rate.
- Zetwork Harish: large volume (120 tons) enquiry; rate revised **down ₹500** mid-negotiation to **₹63.5**, loading extra; separate note that 12mm (coil-cut) carries **rate premium over straight 8–10mm bars**.
- ZIAVUDEEN SHAMSUDHEEN (unclear/possibly garbled transcript): Vizag "தென்னம" rate **₹70 + tax**, later recalculated to ~₹83–84 GST inclusive — shows live rate confirmation/last-minute increase practice ("₹1 சேர்த்து வச்சுட்டோம்").
- Transport/logistics rates mentioned in passing: Chennai–Gudur/Nellore ~₹1800/ton (15–16 ton load); Vizag plant to Vellore/Katpadi ~₹2600 (26 "pack"); interstate (Hyderabad/Raichur–Chennai) ~₹2100–2150/ton via transporter Dushyant.
- Standard commercial terms repeatedly stated: **+GST, +loading, +transport extra** on all basic rates; **payment charges ₹200–250 per vehicle** (disputed by a customer as inconsistent); **Cash & Carry pricing is separate/lower** than credit; **credit terms ~1 month** when available, else advance/full payment required before dispatch.

## Objection Playbook

1. **"Rate konjam kammi pannunga" (price reduction ask)** — Standard response: "rate already low / correct-ஆ இருக்கு, loading/transport extra ஆகும்," offer small concession only (₹200–500/₹1/kg) rather than large cuts, citing rising mill prices ("rate increase ஆகிட்டு இருக்கு", "JSW ₹1000 increase").
   - Example: VASUDEVAN K call — rep holds firm: "Rate elலாமே final தான் sir... increase பண்ணி கொடுத்துட்டு கம்மி பண்றது எல்லாம் பண்ண மாட்டோம்."
2. **Competitor price comparison ("Tata-la 60-ku vangaen")** — Rep clarifies brand/spec difference (ISMB cost structure vs sheet) rather than matching blindly; explains why rate differs (item-specific cost, not apples-to-apples).
3. **Full-advance-payment resistance (especially out-of-state/new trader)** — Firm policy: no vehicle loads without full payment; token advance not accepted for dispatch triggers, as seen in Yashil Mayurkumar Mumbai call — repeated refusal despite customer offering 1–2 lakh advance and citing "sab jagah aise hi transaction kar rahe hain."
4. **Size/weight substitution pushback (contractor rejects heavier spec)** — When required size unavailable (e.g., 2.5mm not in stock, only 2.6/2.9mm available), rep transparently states stock position and offers alternative (local brand like Apollo) rather than overselling: "2.5-ல கிடைக்காது... local brand-ல கிடைக்கும்."
5. **Billing/transport-charge disputes (recurring friction)** — V R Earth Movers repeatedly disputes payment/handling charges (₹200 vs ₹250) and omitted transport charges in invoices; resolution path used: issue a **debit note** to reconcile rather than cancel/reissue e-invoice ("e-way bill போட்டாச்சு, cancel பண்றது ரொம்ப கஷ்டம்").
6. **MTC/Tag mismatch objections (SAIL vs Vizag tag confusion)** — Common in site/QC calls; resolved by cross-checking actual size/grade on physical tag vs system DC, then re-issuing corrected endorsed TC.
7. **Weight-difference/tolerance objection (thickness 2.5 vs 2.6mm)** — fabricator pushback: "அதிகமா போடுறது... எங்களுக்கு காசு கொடுக்க மாட்டாங்க" — rep must find exact spec stock or lose the deal; shows customers are strict on exact thickness for billing reasons downstream.
